I need to identify which US TV series features the characters Henry Blake, Charles Winchester, and Father Mulcahy.

Let me consider what I know about these characters:
- Henry Blake was a commanding officer character
- Charles Winchester was a surgeon character
- Father Mulcahy was a chaplain character

These are all well-known characters from M*A*S*H, the classic TV series set during the Korean War at a Mobile Army Surgical Hospital. Henry Blake (played by McLean Stevenson) was the CO in early seasons, Charles Emerson Winchester III (played by David Ogden Stiers) was a surgeon who joined in later seasons, and Father Francis Mulcahy (played by William Christopher) was the unit's chaplain throughout the series.
